digest.component_or_area: plan-review overlay T13, plan-review routing, code-review surface-parity criterion
propositions: T13 plan-review overlay currently triggers only on newly-forbidden actions (prohibitions); it should also trigger when a plan adds a new obligation (contract, invariant, schema field, required argument, or multi-site dependency)

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py lacks alternation branches for additive-obligation vocabulary ('must stay in sync', 'new required', 'adds a contract'), causing plans with obligation phrasings to be det-skipped before router evaluation

Historical surface-parity widening to include NDJSON/import channels would yield ~70% false positives (28/40 triggers owed nothing); genuine write-parameter parity is now covered deterministically by test_write_parity_oracle.py, making an LLM criterion redundant
P0 import-integrity criterion should be replaced by deterministic CI import walk (full rebar.* importlib traversal + scripts/ leg) rather than an LLM-based criterion

P1 assessment measured 10% genuine-obligation TP rate against ~90%-none precedent class, supporting rejection of content-triggered surface-parity widening unless narrowed to NDJSON/import channel only
P3 obligation-parity overlay rejected in favor of deterministic measurability; P2 prompt-edit approved as minimal-value change with narrow scope (two files + guide regeneration).
